title: Independent review of phenotype extraction from 20 rare disease case reports
description: Two reviewers independently recorded patients, phenotypic findings (Human Phenotype Ontology classes), the basis on which each finding was established, and frequency statements in the abstract and the full text of 20 published case reports of Mendelian disorders, without access to model output or regional assignment. The dataset includes the automated extraction and HPO mapping output for the same 40 documents, a Frictionless data package descriptor, and the reviewer protocol. Source documents are referenced by PMID, PMCID and DOI and are not redistributed.
